publications.title: Learning Heat-Based Equations in Self-Similar Variables
publications.venue: ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI and Partial Differential Equations
publications.summary: A self-similar coordinate framework for learning heat-based PDEs, improving long-time extrapolation in experiments on Navier–Stokes and viscous Burgers equations.
publications.citation: Shihao Wang, Qipeng Qian, and Jingquan Wang. Learning Heat-Based Equations in Self-Similar Variables. ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI and Partial Differential Equations, 2026. arXiv:2602.00872. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2602.00872

publications.title: Beyond Direct Imaging: Quantum Measurement Design for Small-Target Detection in UAV Hyperspectral Sensing
publications.summary: A quantum-assisted framework combines spatial-mode measurements with spectral information to detect small mineral targets, accounting for localization, background uncertainty, and optical losses.
publications.citation: Qipeng Qian, Jialiang Jin, Shihao Wang, and Yuntao Qian. Beyond Direct Imaging: Quantum Measurement Design for Small-Target Detection in UAV Hyperspectral Sensing. arXiv preprint arXiv:2610.39226, 2026. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2610.39226

publications.title: Spatial-Mode Selection for Local Mineral Absorption Spectroscopy
publications.summary: Spatial-mode demultiplexing improves estimates of local mineral absorption by reducing background light before detection, with simulations incorporating alignment, calibration, and acquisition costs.
publications.citation: Qipeng Qian, Jialiang Jin, Shihao Wang, and Yuntao Qian. Spatial-Mode Selection for Local Mineral Absorption Spectroscopy. arXiv preprint arXiv:2610.39221, 2026. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2610.39221

publications.title: QAM: Quadratic-Accurate Checkpoint Merging via Sequential Consistency
publications.summary: A checkpoint-merging rule with provable reconstruction guarantees under a local transition model, evaluated on public language-model training trajectories.
publications.citation: Shihao Wang, Rui Kong, Xinran Chen, Hui Wu, Qipeng Qian, Jinman Zhao, Jiashu Zhao, Yuchen Li, Jimmy Huang, and Dawei Yin. QAM: Quadratic-Accurate Checkpoint Merging via Sequential Consistency. arXiv preprint arXiv:2609.35168, 2026. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.35168
